notes.title: Big update for the Stellar Wanderer DX demo!
notes.content:
Dear explorers,

We are pleased to announce that the Stellar Wanderer DX demo has been updated to version 0.6! This update brings a slew of visual, sound, UX, and localization improvements to the demo.

Check the patch notes below:

- updated environments
- updated capital ships and installations
- updated fighter ships and cockpits
- updated space stations (interior and exterior)
- new jumpgate and dock animations
- new sounds and fxs for engines and weapons
- new explosions
- new localizations. The full list now includes German, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified/Traditional Chinese. This is still in a work in progress, some texts might still show up not translated.
- UI fixes
- many other under-the-hood fixes and improvements

Please don't hesitate to share with us your feedback and any issues you may encounter in the demo on the game's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1401630/discussions/]Community Hub page.[/url]

Stellar Wanderer DX team

notes.title: The Stellar Wanderer DX Demo Is Back! And We're Now At TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023!
notes.content:
Hello explorers!

We are pleased to announce that the Stellar Wanderer DX demo* has returned to STEAM. Starting today, you can also play the demo in Japanese**. 

If you're in Tokyo, you can also head to the Leoful booth (Hall 10, Indie Game Area, 10-E16) at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023 (TGS 2023) to play Stellar Wanderer DX and receive an exclusive postcard! 

Please note the demo available at TGS 2023 is playable only in Japanese. More information can be found on the [url=https://leoful.com/tgs-2023-en]Leoful @ TOKYO GAME SHOW 2023 website[/url].

[i]* The demo will be available to play as long as you like.
** As the demo is based on a version of the game that is currently in development, there may be bugs or certain parts of the game that are unavailable. Please let us know if you encounter any issues in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1401630/discussions/]discussion forum here[/url]. The demo is playable in English and Japanese.[/i]

notes.title: Stellar Wanderer DX lands on PC and consoles in 2024!
notes.content:
Hello, explorers!

Today, we are happy to announce we are teaming up with indie game publisher Leoful to bring old-school open-galaxy space simulation, Stellar Wanderer DX, to PC, Nintendo Switch™, PlayStation®5, Xbox Series X|S, and Xbox One in 2024!

To celebrate this announcement, we have published a new announcement trailer showing you various beautiful locations, activities, and intense combat:

[previewyoutube=jeU1MNExuJ4;full][/previewyoutube]

As you may have noticed, the title for the PC version of the game has been rebranded to Stellar Wanderer DX. This is because we have been working hard to provide you a full deluxe experience on PC and consoles - expanded space systems to explore, highly detailed ships and environments, gameplay balances, support for Japanese and Chinese, and much more.

In addition, you can now try out the Stellar Wanderer DX demo* on Steam during Steam Next Fest: June 2023 from June 19 to June 26, 2023. While the demo provides you a small slice of the full game, we are looking forward to hearing your thoughts and comments!

Dream Builder Studios and Leoful

[i]* Please note that the demo that will be available in June 2023 does not support Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese. A demo with support for these languages will be released in the future.[/i]

notes.title: Stellar Wanderer Dev Diary #2
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings pilots![/h1]

Welcome to our second dev diary. Today we’ll show you our process for improving the game zones. 
First, a disclaimer: the zones that you’ve seen in the demo were built in a specific way to achieve high performance on lower spec machines. For PCs we can improve lots of things without a significant performance loss.

[h1]The Lilla station[/h1]

Lilla is a very well connected border world’s station. What makes it special is that it acts as a transit hub between mid-security trade lanes, core systems and one of the insurgent main bases: Zerand. When playing the demo, this is where you jump to end the final mission after you get chased by hostiles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38613331/c591eca7e6d2bdbccc3c34c4389dc012337181f7.jpg[/img]

[h1]Improving Lilla[/h1]

The first thing we do to every system is to establish a “personality”, something that makes it distinct from all others. This achieves the following:
[list]
[*] We give you, the player, [b]something easy to recognize[/b] and help you with orientation in the world. You should know, for example, without pulling up the map, in which system you are. 
[*] It [b]encourages exploration[/b] of the game world
[*] It allows us to [b]tell a better story[/b] through art and environment
[/list]
The main way to transmit this is through the skybox and environmental art. 

A very distinct high resolution sky, was created to replace the old nebula, as you can see in the images below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38613331/5bc786787f0359a8dc7b6f7374b9f5780cb38f65.jpg[/img]

The second thing was, of course, adjusting the lighting to fit with the new sky. This means light coloring, reflections, back-light, everything.

Then we went on to improve the landmarks, [b]without breaking the missions[/b]. This means creating and adding environmental art (meteorites, debris or installations) in a way it doesn’t intersect all the possible ship traffic. A few visual cues are added to signal the trade lanes and the way to the gates. Now you can get your bearings much easier, even without the help of the HUD. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38613331/3018f40da9b95d8b000a8767f60a75de43d48c73.jpg[/img]

We then added atmospheric effects such as clouds and fog to add an extra touch of depth. This way, the system not only does not feel empty, but wherever you travel you can feel the real speed of the spaceship as you fight, or zoom around the landmarks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38613331/7967b4804e7c847c43bf07958c0b696d99430feb.jpg[/img]

Finally, we had to take care of the station’s hangar, where you’ll spend a lot of time. We have increased the texture resolution, adjusted the lighting, tuned atmospheric effects for a much better experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38613331/98fba878945d4ddf13dec3bb03aadc517ca6626e.jpg[/img]

We hope you’ve enjoyed this developer diary. Make sure to follow us here to see more updates as well as on social media:

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/StellarWanderer]twitter.com/StellarWanderer[/url]
Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/stellarwanderergame]instagram.com/StellarWandererGame[/url]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/StellarWanderer]facebook.com/StellarWanderer[/url]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/6ZDYhu2]discord.com/invite/6ZDYhu2[/url]


Thank you!

notes.title: Stellar Wanderer Dev Diary #1
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, pilots![/h1]

Welcome to our first development update for Stellar Wanderer. This marks the beginning of a periodic series which will keep you up to date with the latest developments on the game. 

[h1]Let’s get started![/h1]

[h2]What’s happening with the demo?[/h2]

The demo has been de-activated as it no longer represents the current state of the game. Ever since our initial launch a few months ago we have been hard at work on improving everything the game. We took every ounce of feedback that you, the players, have given us, combined it with our own ideas and hopefully got something that looks really great!

Once we complete every feature needed for a new version, a new demo build will be uploaded and be ready to play!


[h2]What has changed until now? [/h2]

In short, TONS of things. The list below only shows a few items, but we’ll take some of them apart and detail them in future dev logs. 

[b]Graphics[/b]
•	High resolution models & textures for everything, from player ships to capital ships or stations
•	New hangars for all starbases
•	Improved lighting systems
•	Bloom
•	Added atmospheric effects

[b]Environment[/b]
•	Skyboxes have been reworked (sometimes from scratch) and have much higher resolution
•	Lighting has been redone for all maps
•	More points of interest added throughout all areas
•	Improved debris and speed feedback
•	Pretty clouds and nebulas
•	Gates and routes (in safe systems) are signaled by buoys for easier orientation

[b]Interface & Controls[/b]
•	Custom loading screens for every area
•	Completely reworked menu system
•	Vastly improved mouse input (aiming, shooting and selection)
•	Improved the default keyboard layout 
•	Separated time acceleration and docking inputs
•	Cleaned up and improved the HUD
•	More information is now available in Cockpit view
•	Improved the fonts

[b]Gameplay[/b]
•	Added a Hardcore Aiming mode for people who enjoy a challenge
•	Added possibility to stop the ship and better control the speed 
•	Added Auto-level function
•	Matching speed now works correctly
•	Waypoints set in the system map now remain active until reached or cleared

[b]Other[/b]
•	Improved 3rd person camera for better movement feedback
•	Camera now shakes when things blow up nearby
•	Improved performance 
•	A lot of other minor (and major) bugs fixed

As soon as we have something to show, we will. Until then, make sure to follow/whislist the game on Steam, check out our social media or join our Discord server. 

Twitter: [url=https://twitter.com/StellarWanderer]twitter.com/StellarWanderer[/url]
Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/stellarwanderergame]instagram.com/StellarWandererGame[/url]
Facebook: [url=https://www.facebook.com/StellarWanderer]facebook.com/StellarWanderer[/url]
Discord: [url=https://discord.com/invite/6ZDYhu2]discord.com/invite/6ZDYhu2[/url]

Thank you!

notes.title: Stellar Wanderer Broadcast
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, pilots![/h2]

Join us for a play session of Stellar Wanderer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38613331/051eba2cc81d27caec208395524fcad7b291481b.png[/img]

[h3]About the game[/h3]

[b]Stellar Wanderer[/b] is a beautiful old-school space opera set in a vast open-world universe.

Grow your skills and choose the best path that suits your play style. Become a FIGHTER, TRADER, TANK or ENGINEER, each with its own bonuses and special abilities. Follow the main story line or choose the side missions you would like to play. Prove your space flight skills, mine for resources, transport merchandise, be a respected bounty hunter or even become the most dangerous pirate in the galaxy!
